description: Describes a task definition. You can specify a family and revision to find information about a specific task definition, or you can simply specify the family to find the latest ACTIVE revision in that family.

incidents.description: Tracking TeamPCP: Investigating Post-Compromise Attacks Seen in the Wild

securityImplications: Attackers might use DescribeTaskDefinition to inspect an ECS task definition for its container images, environment variables, and IAM task role, revealing secrets and privileged targets.
